headline: Ramayana is expected to sell 2.22M tickets today; Sunday, a Diwali holiday, could reach 2.57M (range 2.19M–2.83M).
bullets: Today is projected at 2.22M tickets (range 2.12M to 2.32M), which is -21% against yesterday.
The busiest hour still ahead is 12–1 AM, at an estimated 22.9K tickets (range 20.1K to 25.7K), tapering to 2.3K by 2–3 AM.
Tomorrow, Sunday and Diwali, is estimated at 2.57M tickets (range 2.19M to 2.83M), based on the usual Saturday-to-Sunday pattern with a Diwali assumption.
Signals lean the forecast up by 10%: BookMyShow rating +6%, critics +4%, word of mouth 0%, in its opening weekend (day 2 after release). Forecasts have typically missed by a median of 6%.
watch: Mixed word of mouth on storytelling (0%) could shift Sunday's figure if reviews turn negative.
Diwali is assumed to lift tomorrow by x1.12; a weaker holiday effect would pull the Sunday range down.
